name: Shandong Sinocera Functional Material Co., Ltd.
summary: Shandong Sinocera Functional Material Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of ceramic materials and products in China and internationally. The company operates through six segments: Electronic Materials, Catalytic Materials, Biomedical Materials, New Energy Materials, Precision Ceramics, and Digital Printing and Other Materials.
